slides.text: The most common questions about these blends 👉

slides.title: Blends of several peptides
slides.text: GLOW is GHK-Cu, BPC-157 and TB-500. KLOW is the same plus KPV. Sold as “research products”, not as medicines.
Neither blend is approved by the FDA or EMA. There are no clinical trials of the blends themselves.
The ingredients were studied mostly in animals, and GHK-Cu mainly in skin cosmetics. Combining them adds no evidence.

list: BPC-157 and TB-500 are on the WADA banned list
Not knowing what's inside won't prevent a ban
